items.name: Calm dusk
items.author: Forge
items.summary: Slow indigo-to-peach glow, low and gentle.

items.name: Neon pulse
items.author: Forge
items.summary: Four hot neon glows that react hard and move fast.

items.name: Ember
items.author: Forge
items.summary: Warm orange and amber glows, a steady smoulder.

items.name: Ocean depth
items.author: Forge
items.summary: Two deep blue-teal glows drifting slowly.

items.name: Mono mist
items.author: Forge
items.summary: Soft grey and white mist, quiet and neutral.

items.name: Aurora
items.author: Forge
items.summary: Green, cyan, violet and pink glows, lively but smooth.

items.name: Bass lift
items.author: Forge
items.summary: More low end: up to +5 dB below 100 Hz, tapering off by 400 Hz.

items.name: Vocal clarity
items.author: Forge
items.summary: Trims the lows a little and lifts 1-2.5 kHz so voices sit forward.

items.name: Late-night low volume
items.author: Forge
items.summary: Keeps bass and treble audible when listening quietly, softens the top end.

items.name: Gentle treble roll-off
items.author: Forge
items.summary: A generic, unmeasured curve easing 3-20 kHz down by up to 7 dB for bright headphones.
